summary: FDA approved once-daily oral daraxonrasib, marketed as Rasonque, for adults with metastatic pancreatic adenocarcinoma who have received at least one prior systemic therapy or who are not candidates for multiagent systemic therapy. headlines.title: Galleri-NHS negative screening signal
headlines.summary: This is a major cautionary signal for population blood-based multi-cancer screening. A negative primary endpoint should slow premature adoption and reshape how MCED claims are presented to payers and the public.
